noveltyStatus.reason: The deterministic App Governance inventory state emitted the known connector inventory contract and no new permission contract, so rerunning the unchanged state has no expected yield.
noveltyStatus.nextRequirement: Provide a deterministic application-detail or permission view whose expected route or response contract is absent from the Defender XDR baseline.
noveltyStatus.reopenCondition: The App Governance inventory state emits an action-attributed Cloud Apps operation whose request or response contract is not represented in the checked-in Defender baseline.

targets.safeAction: Navigate to App Governance and passively capture inventory and application-detail traffic.
targets.rationale: The inventory and detail views share a product-owned Cloud Apps family with body-bearing list traffic and multiple response shapes that can be captured passively.

targets.safeAction: Navigate to the application permissions details within App Governance and passively capture the normal permission traffic.
targets.rationale: Application permission data is a distinct product-owned family and is central to the user-visible governance view; passive capture can enrich its request and response contract.
